findings.scenario: Completion semantics require reserved care vs reserved consultation. Row 4 (The Practice Beverly Hills) and row 18 (Skinsation LA) are coded confirmed_appointment and then counted as 'Confirmed care appointment' (README table 46-48; README 97, 133-135). Capture-log 11-19 and 32-35 show the inspectable inventory was Consultation - Cosmetic and Virtual Consultation. Athletic Lab/Forged phone calendars are correctly coded booked_consultation (CSV 35,38; capture-log 82-87). Same live-consultation fact pattern is labeled reserved care, so dentistry's 1 care-booking exception and med-spa booked_consultation=0 are false. Playbook freeze would generate 'appointment reserved' copy for consult-only inventory.
findings.remediation: Recode any operator whose observed inventory is a consult/phone/virtual consult as booked_consultation unless a care/treatment slot was actually reserved. Recount the distribution table from recoded rows. Keep confirmed_appointment only for rows like Cienega HydraFacial or Prehab 'Initial Consultation with Treatment'.

findings.scenario: Unknown/unobservable flows must stay indeterminate; README 247 forbids upgrading indeterminate systems to confirmed booking; Limits 241 call identity-gated rows non-authoritative. me.losangeles (availability gated), Dr Refresh (times require identity), Sculpt DTLA (times require identity), and LA-Mi Spa (medium live_endpoint, no recorded times) are still journey_mode=confirmed_appointment and are included in '6 of 13 ... credible confirmed-booking systems' (README 48, 133). No identity was entered, so live care inventory was not observed. That overstates med-spa confirmed-care prevalence and would let ONE BOX emit confirmed_appointment without inspectable slots.
findings.remediation: Set those rows to indeterminate (or keep medium/low in a non-decision stratum). Recompute med-spa confirmed counts from high-confidence live_flow rows with visible times only. Strike 'credible confirmed-booking' until inventory is inspectable without identity.

findings.scenario: Neo Dental: rendered body unavailable, coded appointment_request from the Weave URL label. Beverly Hills Cosmetic Dentistry: external form, no slot or confirmation observed, coded appointment_request. McComb: homepage hash endpoint, no availability, coded appointment_request. Parallel med-spa unobservables (Stoker, SkinLab, Hush, Zenith) are indeterminate. Dentistry therefore reports 12/13 requests and 0 indeterminate (README 46) by defaulting missing inventory to request, violating 'CTA label was never enough' (README 39) and the indeterminate rule.
findings.remediation: Recode uninspectable endpoints as indeterminate regardless of URL/CTA. Recalculate dentistry request/indeterminate counts. Use endpoint_label only as a note, never as the verdict.

findings.scenario: Criterion requires every distribution count and architecture rule to be supported by row-level evidence. The three 'Data-derived homepage order' tables publish 13/13, 9/13, 11/12, etc. quality-order rules, and README 55-67 asserts a shared 8-step acquisition topology. evidence-matrix.csv has no section-sequence, CTA, or module columns—only journey_mode fields. Those frequencies cannot be audited or reproduced, but they are written as generation blueprints.
findings.remediation: Either add per-operator section/CTA fields to the matrix and recompute frequencies from those rows, or remove the numeric homepage-order tables and topology from the decision until that evidence exists.

findings.scenario: Staff-confirmed request vs contact-only fallback is not applied with a stable rule. Top Beverly Hills Dentist and Beverly Hills Dental Arts are contact forms without appointment preferences, coded appointment_request. My Botox LA 'call, text, or email and collects contact details' is appointment_request. Pogson (phone/email/address only) and Sports Rehab LA ('call to book or send a general inquiry') are contact_only. Nearly the same channel-only behavior flips the completion contract, so fallback vs request rates are not evidence-safe.
findings.remediation: Define contact_only as channel-only with no scheduling payload; appointment_request requires stated staff confirm/match plus time/service preferences or an explicit request promise. Recode the contact-form rows against that rule and recount.

findings.scenario: Architecture says hybrid is a router, not a completion state (README 17, 89, 249), and JourneyMode has no hybrid (README 197-201). VERT is stored as journey_mode=hybrid. Capture-log 91-93 only says group classes 'advertise' real-time reservation; PT path is request-info. Implementing from the CSV would treat hybrid as a fourth success state and may treat unverified class ads as live clinical inventory (the PT quality failure at README 189).
findings.remediation: Store VERT as appointment_request (or indeterminate) plus a router/scope flag. Do not put hybrid in journey_mode. Verify class inventory with a live_flow note before claiming a second contract at service scope.

findings.scenario: The decision table counts every core row equally, then Limits say medium/low identity-gated rows 'remain non-authoritative'. Using those mixed-confidence counts as the evidential basis for 'the booking-versus-request binary fails' and for med-spa hybrid strength overclaims what the sample can support. It is not a market-share claim, but it is still an unsafe denominator for a ONE BOX default mix.
findings.remediation: Publish a high-confidence-only distribution beside the full core table. Gate the architecture recommendation on the high-confidence subset; keep medium/low rows out of numerators.

audit.proof_assessment: Core headcounts (13/13/12) match CSV role flags, and several request disclaimers (Beverly Hills Orthodontics, Skin Works, Zakhor, Elite, MOTI) are internally consistent. Capture-log live times only corroborate a minority of confirmed-slot claims, and two of those are consultations. No independent artifact checks the homepage frequencies, identity-gated 'confirmed' rows, or VERT class inventory. Author notes are treated as authority where the method required inspectable inventory.
residual_risks: Playbook freeze that ships confirmed-care CTAs for consult-only or identity-gated schedulers
Dentistry treated as 12/13 request with a care-booking exception that the captured flow does not show
Homepage-order 'quality requirements' becoming generation rules without row evidence
contact_only vs appointment_request leakage producing false promises or missing response-owner gates
Medical/legal/advertising compliance still unreviewed, as the README itself states
